place_id.description: Slug naming the place. Reuse it when the player returns here.

location.description: The wider location of the scene: a station, a ship, a town or a wild region, not a room or a spot in it. Many scenes share one location. Leave it empty when the scene is in the location of THE SCENE NOW. Write a name only when the player arrives in a different location. Use the same name again when the player returns to a location.

title.description: The scene's title, read by the player. Name nothing hidden.

situation.description: The place as it stands: what the player sees, hears and smells here, and what the place offers or blocks. Describe the place. Never narrate an action, and never tell what the player does. Hold nothing hidden here.

present_ids.description: Ids of who and what is in the scene now.

cast.description: New people and things. The engine files each entry under an id made from its name. The player reads a brief and a sheet after they meet that entry. Name nothing still hidden in either one.

^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: A character is a person, an object, a vehicle or a curse.

voice.description: How this person sounds read aloud: feminine, masculine, or other for creatures, machines and voices that are neither.

arc.description: The long game that spans the scenes: pressure, intent and what can come later. Never restate or change what happened, and never what is true in this scene now. The player never reads it. Revise it only where what happened makes a change necessary, else leave it empty.

recap.description: One paragraph on the scene the player leaves: what the player did, paid and learned. The narrator reads it. Name nothing hidden.

goal.description: What the protagonist is here for in this scene, in one line the player reads. Name nothing the player has not met.

details.description: Two to four tags on the place, such as `Slick Cobbles` or `Crowded Market`. The player reads them. Name it in three or four words, never more than 48 characters.
